name: damage-detector
intendedUse: Real-time damage detection on Pakistani-market vehicles
Daylight conditions, handheld phone capture at 30–200 cm
Both ONNX in-browser inference (Live Detection) and PyTorch server-side (Quick Scan)
limitations: Trained on Pakistan-market vehicles only — may underperform on others
May misclassify low-light, heavily blurred, or aerial imagery
No continuous evaluation — drift not monitored

evaluation.note: Test metrics not available. Models inherited from new-webxr without provenance. See docs/live-detection-analysis/07-yolo-detection-deep-dive.md for retraining plan.

knownIssues: Letterbox pad colour (#808080) may not match training pad (typically #727272)
Single global confidence threshold across all classes
NMS IoU threshold not tuned per class
